ns2:course.label: Text to Stage
ns2:course.description: Practical exploration of theatre production for Theatre majors with emphasis on the collaborative contributions of playwrights, actors, directors, designers, and dramaturges, culminating in final group projects in planning productions of one-act plays. Attendance at Department of Theatre productions required. Credit not given for both THEA 101 and THEA 102. This course is required for all Theatre Majors.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit not given for both THEA 101 and THEA 102. This course is required for all Theatre Majors.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Theatre department.
